source: CEPII BACI V202601, based on UN Comtrade

natural_uranium.title: Natural uranium and compounds
natural_uranium.boundary: Material trade for all listed forms; not uranium mining output, inventories or conversion services.

enriched_products.title: Enriched uranium or plutonium products
enriched_products.boundary: The HS heading combines enriched uranium, plutonium and compounds; it does not isolate enrichment services.

reactors.title: Nuclear reactors
reactors.boundary: Rare, lumpy project shipments; customs value is not installed or operating capacity.

reactor_parts.title: Nuclear-reactor parts
reactor_parts.boundary: A broad parts heading without component, material, quality or project-status detail.
